name: done-milestone-status-closeout
title: Render DONE milestone status from the frozen closeout snapshot
description: After B-e62e reached DONE on 2026-07-05, story_advance correctly captured milestone-closeout.json but the automatically appended Milestone Status table recomputed live evidence after active-story cleanup and falsely showed stale or blocked rows. Developers need the DONE display to read the durable closeout snapshot so the final table stays stable.
